title: Deep learning and generative AI
subtitle: Learn the model concepts behind the interfaces without confusing them with implemented features.
goal: Understand what the model can and cannot do
intro: You need a practical model of prediction before deciding what a model should control.
terms: A unit of model input or output
case: An assistant rewrites a delivery message and answers a factual shipping question.
Both produce text, but only the factual task needs external verification.
Fluent prediction can invent a delivery date.
